observations: Photo 0 shows a front-load washing machine with an LG logo and text “DirectDrive 6/3kg” on the left panel.
The control panel and display area are visible; no clear brand/model text for Samsung is visible in the photo.
Seller text says “Samsung” and “scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair,” but the photo appears to be LG.

read_from: photo 0 left panel (LG logo and “DirectDrive 6/3kg” text)

claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair.
claims.evidence: Seller words match the general condition implied by “scrap” and “doesn’t work,” but the photo alone does not show it is non-working; only the LG identity is supported by photo 0.
Photo 0 shows LG logo and “DirectDrive 6/3kg”; no Samsung branding is visible.

risks.risk: Brand mismatch: seller says Samsung, but the photo shows LG DirectDrive 6/3kg. This affects parts compatibility and resale value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the rating/serial plate (model number) and the brand label on the back or side, plus a photo of the front door frame label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-working washing machine for scrap/repair with the brand as shown in the photo (LG), not Samsung.

risks.risk: “Doesn’t work” could mean anything (dead power, drain/heating fault, door lock fault). Without a test, the repair cost is unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: plug in, press start, show any error code on the display, and show whether the drum turns/drains.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst case: not working and needs repair (no working confirmation).

risks.risk: Capacity/model mismatch (6/3kg vs other sizes) changes parts and demand.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the full model number from the rating plate (e.g., “Model: …”) and the capacity listed there.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smallest/least-demand variant among the comparables (worst-case for value).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating/serial plate showing the exact model number and brand (not just the front panel).
Send a short video of the machine being powered on and running a cycle attempt, showing any error code and whether it drains/spins.
Confirm whether it is washer-only or washer+dryer (photo shows “Washer+Dryer 2 in 1,” but confirm from the model plate).
response.reason: The photo contradicts the seller’s stated brand (Samsung vs LG DirectDrive 6/3kg). Without the exact model/serial plate and a power-on/error-code video, the correct worst-case pricing cannot be confidently matched to the comparables.
